name: Native Steam Keyboard Enhancement
summary: Enhances the original Steam keyboard for everyday Desktop Mode typing: flush top/bottom placement with a move key, a real Hide key, transparency, Ctrl/Alt keys, long-press symbols, genuine Tab/Shift+Tab form navigation, Multilingual Input Support (KDE layout follows the Steam keyboard language for every language with an XKB layout; input-method languages stay on Steam's native path), the keyboard above Plasma popups, and Legion Go sticks/triggers/touchpad/D-pad while it is open. Applied at runtime; no Steam files are patched.
restart: Restart Steam once if the installer enabled Steam's local debugger; otherwise the keyboard is enhanced the next time it opens.
